description.value: Fatburger Nanaimo is a casual burger restaurant on Rutherford Road offering cooked-to-order burgers made with fresh, never-frozen Alberta Angus beef. A Canadian-owned franchise of the iconic chain founded in 1952, it offers a broad menu including plant-based burgers, chicken, milkshakes, and poutine. Takeout and delivery are available, making it a convenient fuelling stop for cyclists in the south Nanaimo area.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Fatburger Nanaimo is open and operating at 12-4890 Rutherford Road, Nanaimo, BC, V9T 5M1; phone 250 585 5700 matches OSM. OSM takeaway=yes is corroborated by the website's 'ORDER TAKE-OUT OR DELIVERY' call-to-action. Plant-based burgers are explicitly listed on the menu, confirming vegetarian/vegan options; no evidence of cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi) appears anywhere in the website content.
